They're sending in raiders!|Beginning of Wave 17 ([[Area 51]])}} {{QuoteBox|Fire and ice!|Beginning of Wave 19 ([[Area 51]])}} }} __TOC__ == Description == The '''Raider 1''' was an [[Area 51]] [[Enemies|enemy]] that only appeared during the [[Area 51 Event]]. It was the first raider to appear. It had the same speed as the [[Lawnmower]] and [[UFO (Area 51)|UFO]], though it had much more health than both of them. It carried a gun which set a specific tower on fire when shot with the ''Fire Gun'' ability, stunning them for a long period of time. == Appearance == The '''Raider 1''' had green skin, a grey torso, black gloves and dark grey armor. It had dark navy legs and had a gas tank on its back, possibly as ammunition for the fire gun it wielded. The '''Raider 1''' also had a drooling zombie face. == Strategy == *The '''Raider 1''' is immobile for a few seconds while it aims at a tower. **This makes it vulnerable when it is aiming at a tower. Try to have long-ranged towers damage the '''Raider 1''' once it is immobile. *Weak towers, such as the [[Scout]], can be used to direct the '''Raider 1's''' firepower away from the main towers. *Since you get a paycheck just before you encounter this [[Enemies|enemy]], try to get high DPS towers, such as the [[Turret]] and [[Commando]]. *The '''Raider 1''' will not target the [[Farm]], [[Sentry]], [[Turret]], [[Military Base]] or spawned [[units]]. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} E0071226890c31604a0043399d948def.jpg|'''Raider 1''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} 135b54c7b68a46cf7afe86ce8badb7f5.png|'''Raider 1''' on the game icon. IconK.png|'''Raider 1''' on the game icon. {{GalleryHeader|Renders}} Area51ThumbnailClean.png|'''Raider 1''' on a render. }} == Trivia == *The '''Raider 1''' was a reference to the ''Storm Area 51, They Can't Stop All of Us'' event where masses of people would have raided the ''Nevada Test and Training Range''. *The gun used by the '''Raider 1''' is the {{RLinkC|102705430|Incinerator-6000}} gear from the Roblox catalog. == Update History == *'''9 August 2019''' - [[BETA v1.9|BETA v1.9.0]] **'''Raider 1''' added. *'''13 October 2019''' - [[Release v1.0|Release v1.0.0]] **'''Raider 1''' removed. {{Area51|[[UFO (Area 51)|UFO]]|Wave 15|Raider 1|Wave 17|[[Raider 2]]|Wave 18}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
